decision_question: What deserves analysis in this invented mixed corpus?

candidates.title: Workbook evidence health
candidates.question: Which workbook quality conditions can change how later analysis should be interpreted?
candidates.why_worthwhile: Quality conditions can invalidate otherwise persuasive comparisons.

limitations: Repeated text still needs scope review.

candidates.counterexample_check: A shared sentence may be an intentional common template.
candidates.failure_condition: Reject the angle if the repeated text cannot be traced to more than one workbook.

candidates.title: Best visual design
candidates.question: Which workbook image is most effective?
candidates.why_worthwhile: A winner could guide future design.

limitations: No semantic review or performance labels exist.

candidates.counterexample_check: An attractive image may perform poorly.
candidates.failure_condition: Reject without reviewed images and matched performance outcomes.
candidates.rejection_reason: The required visual and performance evidence is unavailable.
